e.body:
宏利（Manulife）在香港寿险与强积金（[[mpfe]]）市场居前列。

## 招聘方向

e.body_en: Manulife is a key Hong Kong life and MPF player. Hiring: actuarial, investment, risk and financial planning. Open positions are posted on channels such as [[linkedin]].
